 Live Blog: Bayern Munich vs. Köln | Bundesliga
 Bayern Munich return to the Allianz Arena determined to protect their unbeaten record and remain at the top of the Bundesliga standings. Standing in their way are Köln, who are enduring a difficult spell but will be hoping to produce one of the biggest upsets of Matchday 10.
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich vs Köln 🐐 
 45+4' – Halftime in Munich! 
 An action-packed first half comes to an end at the Allianz Arena ! 🐐 Köln stunned the hosts through Mikey Moore , but 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich fought back with an equalizer from Nathaniel Brown . However, Harry Kane's injury remains a major concern for the Bavarians heading into the second half.
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich 1-1 Köln 🐐 
 45' – Four Minutes of Added Time! 
 We'll play until the 49th minute at the Allianz Arena ! 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich and 🐐 Köln have four additional minutes before halftime. There's still time for more drama in this first half!
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich 1-1 Köln 🐐 
 36' – GOOOOOOOOAL FOR BAYERN! WE'RE LEVEL IN MUNICH! 
 The Allianz Arena erupts! 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich find the equalizer through a brilliant strike from Nathaniel Brown , who unleashed a powerful low shot from outside the box that nestled just inside the post. The Bavarians are back in the game!
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich 1-1 Köln 🐐 
 35' – Bayern Keep Pushing for the Equalizer! 
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich are searching for an equalizer from every angle, but they simply cannot break through 🐐 Köln's defensive wall. The visitors are putting on an impressive defensive display, holding firm against wave after wave of Bavarian attacks.
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich 0-1 Köln 🐐 
 30' – Köln Look Dangerous on the Counterattack! 
 🐐 Köln are looking to hurt 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich with quick counterattacks, exploiting the spaces left behind by the hosts. The Bavarians continue to dominate possession, but they now face another challenge: Harry Kane is no longer there to lead the attack inside the box.

 21' – TERRIBLE NEWS FOR BAYERN! KANE FORCED OFF INJURED! 
 Alarm bells are ringing at the Allianz Arena ! Harry Kane , the reigning Ballon d'Or winner, is struggling with a physical issue and cannot continue. Vincent Kompany is forced into an unexpected substitution, with Jamal Musiala coming on in his place. A massive blow for 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich , who are already trailing!
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich 0-1 Köln 🐐 
 20' – Bayern Turn Up the Pressure! 
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich remain in control, but they're now playing with much greater intensity. After conceding the opener, the Bavarians are pushing forward in search of an equalizer against a 🐐 Köln side determined to protect their lead.

 11' – GOOOOOOAL FOR KÖLN! A HUGE SHOCK IN MUNICH! 
 Unbelievable scenes at the Allianz Arena ! 🐐 Köln strike first through Mikey Moore , who cut past Jonas Urbig before finishing to give the visitors the lead. Moore's first goal puts 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich under pressure!
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich 0-1 Köln 🐐 
 10' – Bayern in Complete Control! 
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich are comfortably dominating the opening stages. The Bavarians are controlling possession and dictating the tempo, while 🐐 Köln look to withstand the hosts' pressure.

 5' – Kane Comes Close! 
 So close for 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich ! Harry Kane struck the post with his shot, but the play was ruled offside. An early warning from the Bavarians!

 Kickoff in Munich! 
 The ball is rolling at the Allianz Arena ! 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich and 🐐 Köln kick off this exciting Bundesliga clash. The opening 45 minutes are underway!

 Preview 
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich and 🐐 Köln are already warming up on the pitch at the Allianz Arena . Everything is getting ready for an exciting night of Bundesliga action!
 🔴⚪ Bayern Munich vs Köln 🐐 
 Bayern Munich Aim to Extend Their Unbeaten Bundesliga Run
 Vincent Kompany's side have made an impressive start to the season. After nine matchdays, the Bavarians have collected 21 points from six wins and three draws, scoring 29 goals while conceding just nine.
 Bayern Munich are also unbeaten in their last 24 Bundesliga matches, a remarkable run highlighting their consistency and ability to deliver results against demanding opponents.
 The biggest news for Bayern supporters is the return of Vincent Kompany to the touchline after missing five competitive matches for health reasons.
 The Belgian coach returns to a team that recently defeated Mainz 2-1 and secured an important victory against Atlético de Madrid in the Champions League .
 In attack, Harry Kane will be one of the players to watch. Although the English striker has recently struggled to find the net for his club, he has demonstrated another dimension to his game through his ability to create chances for his teammates.
 Köln Look to End Their Difficult Run Against Bayern
 Köln travel to Munich with nine points, sitting 15th in the standings.
 René Wagner's team have failed to win their last four Bundesliga matches, increasing the pressure ahead of a visit to one of Germany's most intimidating stadiums.
 History also favors the hosts. Bayern Munich are unbeaten in their last 22 league meetings with Köln , recording 20 victories and two draws.
 One player capable of making a difference for the visitors is Saïd El Mala , the young forward who has emerged as one of Köln's main attacking threats.
 However, the challenge will be enormous. Bayern Munich have already scored 20 goals in their opening four home matches of the Bundesliga season.

 Bayern Munich 
 November 7: Mainz 1-2 Bayern Munich — Win

 Köln

 October 11: Köln 2-1 Borussia Mönchengladbach — Win
 The results reveal two very different situations. Bayern Munich have collected 11 of the last 15 available points, while Köln have managed just five.

 Köln will attempt to end a 22-match winless league run against the Bavarian giants.
